title: Setting up the sprinkler irrigation system
summary: Planning, choosing the plumbing materials, assembling the sprinkler risers, and maintenance for gentle, even water coverage.

pages.title: Introduction to sprinkler irrigation
pages.text: We will show you how to set up a **sprinkler irrigation system** on a **bio-intensive, living-soil** market garden.
pages.illustration_description: Illustration pédagogique pour Introduction à l’irrigation par aspersion

pages.title: What is sprinkler irrigation?
pages.text:
Water is pressurized, then dispersed as **fine droplets** that mimic natural rainfall. This provides an **even distribution of water** and creates a microclimate.

This semi-automatic system reduces manual work and saves time.
pages.illustration_description: Illustration pédagogique pour L’irrigation par aspersion, qu’est-ce que c’est ?

pages.title: Setup time and organization
pages.text:
The setup is done in **5 steps**.

If all the equipment is on hand, the job takes no more than **half a day for two people** for a plot of **10 beds** (approximately **100 to 120 m²**).
pages.illustration_description: Illustration pédagogique pour Durée et organisation de la mise en place

pages.title: Components of a plot equipped with sprinklers
pages.text: Discover the three essential elements that make up a complete sprinkler irrigation installation.
pages.illustration_description: Illustration pédagogique pour Constitution d’une parcelle équipée en aspersion

pages.title: The water source
pages.text: You need a **water source**, for example a well, a borehole, a water tower, a river, or a stream.
pages.illustration_description: Illustration pédagogique pour La source d’eau

pages.title: The pumping station
pages.text: You also need a **pumping station**: a **combustion-engine or solar pump** to draw the water and pressurize it.
pages.illustration_description: Illustration pédagogique pour La station de pompage

pages.title: The water distribution system
pages.text:
Water is carried to the plot through the **distribution system**, made up of:

- **One main line**
- **2 secondary lines**, also called "sprinkler lines"
- **4 sprinkler risers**
pages.illustration_description: Illustration pédagogique pour Le système de distribution d’eau

pages.title: Plumbing materials and tools required
pages.text: Before starting the job, gather all the pipes, fittings, valves, and tools needed for assembly.
pages.illustration_description: Illustration pédagogique pour Le matériel de plomberie et les outils nécessaires

pages.title: Materials for the main and secondary lines
pages.text:
To assemble the main and secondary lines, you need the following materials:

- **One 40 mm pipe**: the length depends on the distance to the water source
- **One 32 mm pipe** with a length of **20 m**
- **2 reducing tees 40/32 mm**
- **4 valves of 32 mm**
- **1 valve of 40 mm**
pages.illustration_description: Illustration pédagogique pour Matériel pour les lignes principales et secondaires

pages.title: Materials for the sprinkler risers
pages.text:
To assemble the sprinkler risers, you need the following items:

- **4 reducing tees 32/25 mm**
- **4 PEX pipes** (cross-linked polyethylene), **1 m** each
- **4 male adapters 25/15 mm**
- **4 female valves of 15 mm**
- **4 stakes**, **1 m** each
- **PTFE sealing tape (Teflon tape)**
pages.illustration_description: Illustration pédagogique pour Matériel pour les cannes d’aspersion

pages.title: Tools needed for assembly
pages.text:
You will need the following tools:

- **Hacksaw**
- **Knife**
- **Liquid soap** to make fitting the parts together easier
- **Tape measure**
- **String**
pages.illustration_description: Illustration pédagogique pour Outils nécessaires au montage

pages.title: Step 1: Plan the installation
pages.text: To install the sprinkler system on a plot of **10 beds** (approximately **100 to 120 m²**), start by planning the placement of the sprinklers.
pages.illustration_description: Illustration pédagogique pour Étape 1 : Planifier l’installation

pages.title: Sprinkler range
pages.text:
To ensure even sprinkling, plan the layout of the sprinklers according to their range.

The sprinkler range is **3 to 6 m in diameter** depending on the pressure.
pages.illustration_description: Illustration pédagogique pour Portée des asperseurs

pages.title: Number of sprinklers for 10 beds
pages.text: For a plot of **10 beds** (approximately **100 to 120 m²**), you will install **4 sprinklers** to cover the entire area uniformly.
pages.illustration_description: Illustration pédagogique pour Nombre d’asperseurs pour 10 planches

pages.title: Step 2: Install the main pipe and the secondary pipes
pages.text: Once the plan is validated, lay out the distribution network on the ground of your **10-bed** plot.
pages.illustration_description: Illustration pédagogique pour Étape 2 : Installer le tuyau principal et les tuyaux secondaires

pages.title: Laying the main line
pages.text: Place the **40 mm pipe** of the main line along the edge of the plot.
pages.illustration_description: Illustration pédagogique pour Poser la ligne principale

pages.title: Installing the end-of-line valve
pages.text:
Install the **40 mm valve** at the end of the main pipe for maintenance and for extending the irrigation system if needed.

⚠️ **Watch out**: To make it easier to push pipes onto valves and tees, always put **one or two drops of liquid soap** on the joints.
pages.illustration_description: Illustration pédagogique pour Installer la vanne de fin de ligne

pages.title: Positioning the secondary lines
pages.text:
For the secondary lines (sprinkler lines):

1. Place the first **32 mm pipe** in the **4th walkway**.
2. Place the second **32 mm pipe** in the **8th walkway**.
pages.illustration_description: Illustration pédagogique pour Positionner les lignes secondaires

pages.title: Cutting the main pipe
pages.text: Cut the **40 mm** main pipe with a knife or a hacksaw at the **4th and 8th walkways**, where the secondary pipes are installed.
pages.illustration_description: Illustration pédagogique pour Sectionner le tuyau principal

pages.title: Connecting the 40/32 mm tees
pages.text: Install the **2 reducing tees 40/32 mm** on the 40 mm main pipe, then connect the **32 mm** secondary pipes.
pages.illustration_description: Illustration pédagogique pour Raccorder les tés 40/32 mm

pages.title: Installing the valves on the secondary lines
pages.text:
Install the **4 valves of 32 mm** at the start and at the end of each secondary line.

This will make maintenance and any future extension of the irrigation system easier.
pages.illustration_description: Illustration pédagogique pour Installer les vannes des lignes secondaires

pages.title: Step 3: Assemble the sprinkler risers
pages.text: With the main network and the sprinkler lines in place, you will now assemble and secure the **4 sprinkler risers**.
pages.illustration_description: Illustration pédagogique pour Étape 3 : Monter les cannes d’aspersion

pages.title: Driving in the support stakes
pages.text:
1. Measure **3 m** from the start of the bed to place the first support stake.
2. Then measure **4 m** from the first stake to place the second stake (**3 m** remain to the end of the bed).
3. Repeat these steps on the second secondary line.
pages.illustration_description: Illustration pédagogique pour Planter les piquets de stabilisation

pages.title: Cutting the lines at the stakes
pages.text: Cut the **32 mm** secondary lines at the stakes to install the **4 reducing tees** (or tapping saddles) of **32/25 mm**.
pages.illustration_description: Illustration pédagogique pour Couper les rampes au niveau des piquets

pages.title: Installing the 32/25 mm tee
pages.text: Connect the **32/25 mm reducing tee** (or tapping saddle) to the secondary line.
pages.illustration_description: Illustration pédagogique pour Installer le té de raccordement 32/25 mm

pages.title: Connecting the 1 m PEX pipe
pages.text: Connect the **1 m PEX pipe** (cross-linked polyethylene) vertically to the tee.
pages.illustration_description: Illustration pédagogique pour Connecter le tuyau PER de 1 m

pages.title: Attaching the 25/15 mm male adapter
pages.text: Next, attach the **25/15 mm male adapter** to the PEX pipe: the male adapter fits onto the upper end of the pipe.
pages.illustration_description: Illustration pédagogique pour Relier le raccord mâle 25/15 mm

pages.title: Components of the male adapter
pages.text:
Here are the components of the **25/15 mm** male adapter, to be assembled in order:

- **Body**
- **Support ring**
- **O-ring**
- **Compression ring**
- **Tightening nut**
pages.illustration_description: Illustration pédagogique pour Composition du raccord mâle

pages.title: Assembling the male adapter on the PEX pipe
pages.text: Slide the tightening nut, the compression ring, the O-ring, and the support ring onto the **PEX pipe**, then screw firmly onto the adapter body to ensure a watertight connection.
pages.illustration_description: Illustration pédagogique pour Assemblage du raccord mâle sur le tuyau PER

pages.title: Applying Teflon tape to the male adapter
pages.text: To ensure a watertight seal without damaging the male thread, wrap **two turns of Teflon tape** in the direction of the thread.
pages.illustration_description: Illustration pédagogique pour Poser le téflon sur le raccord mâle

pages.title: Connecting the male adapter to the female valve
pages.text: Screw the **15 mm female valve** onto the male adapter fitted with Teflon tape.
pages.illustration_description: Illustration pédagogique pour Relier le raccord mâle à la vanne femelle

pages.title: Purpose of the 15 mm female valve
pages.text:
The **15 mm female valves** installed under the sprinkler heads allow you to open or close **each sprinkler individually** for maintenance.

You therefore do not need to shut down the whole system if there is a fault or a leak at one sprinkler.
pages.illustration_description: Illustration pédagogique pour Utilité de la vanne femelle 15 mm

pages.title: Installing the sprinkler head
pages.text:
1. Wrap **two turns of Teflon tape** around the thread of the sprinkler head, in the direction of the thread.
2. Then connect the **sprinkler head** to the female valve.
pages.illustration_description: Illustration pédagogique pour Installer la tête d’arrosage

pages.title: Assembling the other three risers
pages.text: Repeat exactly the same steps to assemble the **three other sprinkler risers**.
pages.illustration_description: Illustration pédagogique pour Monter les trois autres cannes

pages.title: Securing the risers to the stakes
pages.text: Tie the **4 sprinkler risers** firmly to the support stakes with **string** so that they stay upright under pressure.
pages.illustration_description: Illustration pédagogique pour Fixer les cannes aux piquets

pages.title: Step 4: Pressurizing the system
pages.text: Your installation is assembled: it is now time to test the whole network under real conditions.
pages.illustration_description: Illustration pédagogique pour Étape 4 : Mise sous pression du système

pages.title: Testing operation and watertightness
pages.text:
Test the system to check that it **works properly** and that there are **no leaks**.

This lets you validate the range and uniformity of the sprinklers according to the **available flow rate** and **pressure**.
pages.illustration_description: Illustration pédagogique pour Tester le fonctionnement et l’étanchéité

pages.title: Step 5: Maintaining your irrigation system
pages.text: Regular maintenance ensures the longevity of your equipment and consistent watering quality throughout the crop cycles.
pages.illustration_description: Illustration pédagogique pour Étape 5 : Entretenir son système d’irrigation

pages.title: Routine maintenance tasks
pages.text:
To keep your installation in perfect condition:

- **Visual check**: each time you start the system, make sure it is working correctly and that there are no leaks.
- **Greasing**: regularly grease the rotating parts.
- **Cleaning the nozzles**: make sure the sprinkler nozzles are not clogged by **limescale** or **organic debris**.
pages.illustration_description: Illustration pédagogique pour Les gestes d’entretien réguliers

pages.title: Irrigation system ready to use
pages.text: **Congratulations!** You have just learned how to build your own **sprinkler irrigation system**.
pages.illustration_description: Illustration pédagogique pour Système d’irrigation prêt à l’emploi
